s_10040.text_2: The center of the top face must be a Mechanical Press.
s_10040.text_3: The center of the bottom face must be a Bio Packager.
s_10040.text_4: The frame of the structure is built from Explosion-Proof Casing.
s_10040.text_5: The center block of any side face, except the top and bottom, can be replaced with Blast-Proof Glass.
s_10040.text_6: In addition, every structure must include a Blast Chamber Core.
s_10040.text_7: It also needs two Explosion-Proof Item Vaults of any size; connected vaults count as one.
s_10040.text_8: After the structure forms, the top edges are automatically replaced with Encased Chain Drives.
s_10040.text_9: You can use a Wrench to swap between casings and chain drives, but enough chain drives must remain to power every press.
s_10040.title: Creeper Blast Chamber Assembly
s_2c227.text_1: The Creeper Blast Chamber can handle speeds up to 128 RPM.
s_2c227.text_2: Any speed above 128 RPM will send it into an overloaded state.
s_2c227.text_3: Do not overload it for too long, unless you want an explosion big enough to destroy your base!
s_2c227.title: Creeper Blast Chamber Overload
s_a77f7.text_1: Feed a high-pressure creeper into the chamber...
s_a77f7.text_2: to switch recipes into High-Pressure Implosion mode.
s_a77f7.text_3: High-Pressure Implosion mode has its own recipes and no longer runs Crushing Wheel recipes.
s_a77f7.text_4: Of course, overload explosions also become much more powerful.
s_a77f7.title: Creeper Blast Chamber High-Pressure Implosion
s_c38b1.text_1: The Blast Chamber Core can input and output creepers using cardboard boxes.
s_c38b1.text_2: The largest blast chamber can have up to 9 creepers working at once.
s_c38b1.text_4: For each creeper inside, the chamber takes one batch of items from the input vault, runs the matching Crushing Wheel recipe, and outputs the result to the output vault.
s_c38b1.text_5: Hold right-click on a vault to switch it between input and output.
s_c38b1.title: Creeper Blast Chamber Operation
scene_1.text_1: This is a Creeper Blast Chamber.
scene_1.text_2: It can process Crushing Wheel recipes efficiently in bulk.
scene_1.text_3: Or... are you looking for something more explosive?
